# Nan Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** ten year old  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P15](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0015)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P15](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0015)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Nan  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P15](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0015)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Nan is very pretty, possessing a faultless complexion that brings great satisfaction to her mother. Her features include velvety nut-brown eyes and silky hair of the same nut-brown shade.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P15](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0015)_

## Personality

Nan is a proud individual who is prone to holding long-standing grudges over past insults. She harbors a desire to travel to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) once she is grown up.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P116](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0116), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P30](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0030), [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P1](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0001)_

## History

Nan Blythe was born at [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) and spent time with the children of [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley). She occasionally clashed with [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), who fascinated the local children with ghost stories. Later, Nan encouraged [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) to visit [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) and ask if she would adopt Mary.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P8](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P15](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0015), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P19](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0019), [v5 CHAPTER VI. ## Quotes

> "Oh, Mary, I’ve news for you. Mrs. Elliott has been over-harbour and what do you think she found out? Mrs. Wiley is dead—she was found dead in bed the morning after you ran away. So you’ll never have to go back to her."
>
> — Nan Blythe — [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES P39](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0039)

> "Mother can’t live without trees and I can’t, so what would be the use of going to heaven if there weren’t any trees?"
>
> — Nan Blythe — [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P34](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0034)

> "No—not exactly—but I think it means that heaven will be just like what you’d like it to be."
>
> — Nan Blythe — [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P42](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0042)

> "Mrs. Elliott might take Mary herself. She has a great big house and Mr. Elliott is always wanting her to have help. It would be just a splendid place for Mary. Only she’d have to behave herself."
>
> — Nan Blythe — [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P8](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0008)

> "You are very grateful, I must say."
>
> — Nan Blythe — [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P15](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0015)

## Affiliations

## Relationships

### [Faith](../character/faith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/faith--nan-blythe.md)

Nan and [Faith](../character/faith.md) are close playmates who spend time together in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) alongside the other local children. When [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) comes to live at the manse, Nan and [Faith](../character/faith.md) occasionally clash with her, while also uniting with each other to defend their group against her. Nan also encourages [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) to take bold action to help secure a stable home for Mary when Mrs. [Wiley](../character/wiley.md) dies.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P8](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P15](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0015), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P19](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0019), +11 more_

- Friend of — playmates and playmates' defense against Mary  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P14](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0014), [v5 CHAPTER XXV. ANOTHER SCANDAL AND ANOTHER “EXPLANATION” P11](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0011)</sub>

### [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nan-blythe--una-meredith.md)

Nan is a friend to [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) and supports her when challenges arise among the children. When [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) requires a new home, Nan directly encourages [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) to ask [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) to adopt her. Nan also stands by [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) and the other Meredith children when they face public scrutiny and accusations, such as when [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) accidentally perform house cleaning on a Sunday.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P5](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P17](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0017), [v5 CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES P42](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0042), +6 more_

- Friend of — defends them against accusations  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P14](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0014)</sub>
